input: Compare travel insurance plans for Southeast Asia

gold.taskTitle: Compare travel insurance plans for Southeast Asia
gold.taskDescription: Research and compare travel insurance plans suitable for a trip to Southeast Asia.

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian countries will you be visiting?
questions.description: Identify the specific countries in the itinerary to ensure coverage applies.

questions.title: How long is the total duration of your trip?
questions.description: Determine the trip length to match policy coverage periods.

questions.title: How many travelers need to be covered by the plan?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is for a solo traveler, couple, family, or group.

questions.title: What is your biggest coverage priority for this trip?
questions.description: Understand whether the user prioritizes medical, trip cancellation, baggage, adventure sports, or another type of coverage.

questions.title: Will you be doing any adventure activities like diving or trekking?
questions.description: Determine if high-risk activities require specialized coverage add-ons.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for an insurance plan?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter and compare plans appropriately.

questions.title: Which country are you purchasing the insurance from?
questions.description: Identify the user's home country or country of purchase, as available plans and regulations vary by market.
